title: MedSegBenchmarker: A Raw-Count-First Framework for Controlled 2D Medical Image Segmentation Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2608.29677v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite rapid advances in MIS, fair and reproducible comparisons of segmentation models remain challenging due to heterogeneous datasets, inconsistent evaluation protocols, and rapidly evolving architectures. In particular, comparisons often implicitly assume that model rankings are invariant to data partitioning, preprocessing, metric aggregation, uncertainty estimation, and computational constraints. The lack of extensible and unified evaluation frameworks further limits systematic investigation of new models, datasets, and training paradigms. We present MEDSEGBENCHMARKER (MSB), a configuration-driven framework for controlled benchmarking of 2D MIS. It integrates duplicate and near-duplicate image detection, group-aware data splitting, YAML study specifications, resumable training, hyperparameter optimization, cross-validation, and checkpoint-based evaluation. translated_title: MedSegBenchmarker：一个以原始计数优先的受控二维医学图像分割基准测试框架
translated_abstract: 尽管医学图像分割（MIS）领域取得了快速进展，但由于数据集异构、评估协议不一致以及架构快速演进，分割模型的公平且可复现的比较仍然充满挑战。特别是，模型比较往往隐含地假设模型排名对数据划分、预处理、指标聚合、不确定性估计和计算约束等因素是不变的。缺乏可扩展且统一的评估框架进一步限制了对新模型、数据集和训练范式的系统性研究。我们提出了MEDSEGBENCHMARKER（MSB），一个配置驱动的二维医学图像分割受控基准测试框架。它集成了重复及近似重复图像检测、组感知数据划分、YAML研究规范、可恢复训练、超参数优化、交叉验证以及基于检查点的评估。MSB不仅保留聚合性能指标，还导出样本级别的结果……
tldr: 提出了配置驱动的MedSegBenchmarker框架，通过集成重复图像检测、组感知数据划分、可恢复训练和基于检查点的评估等功能，实现了二维医学图像分割模型受控且可复现的基准测试。
en_tdlr: MedSegBenchmarker is a configuration-driven framework that enables controlled and reproducible benchmarking of 2D medical image segmentation models by integrating duplicate detection, group-aware data splitting, resumable training, and checkpoint-based evaluation.
